messages.subject: winter quarter work group: Tues, 12-2pm
parts:
Hello DRUG!

After much behind-the-scenes movement, we have settled upon Tuesdays from 12-2pm in 360 Shields Library (DSI) for the winter work group. We will hold our first session tomorrow.

As a heads up, the DSI is busy this quarter, so there will be classes right before and after our working group.

(thanks Kestrel for the reminder to send this out!)
